insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (document mentions: "Sum Insured Opted for and for which the premium is paid")

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Applicable for diseases other than Disability / HIV/AIDS: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases – Code Excl 01
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of the first policy. You must maintain continuous coverage for 3 years before claims for pre-existing conditions are payable.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 2. Speciﬁed disease/procedure waiting period – Code Excl 02
good.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies to specified diseases and procedures. You will not get coverage for these conditions until after 2 years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 3. 30-day waiting period – Code Excl 03
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days of the policy, except for accidents. This is a common industry practice to prevent immediate claims.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period of 60 days from the date of discharge from the hospital...
good.explanation: Medical expenses after discharge are covered for 60 days, which meets the standard coverage period. This helps cover follow-up treatments after hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room, Boarding, Nursing Expenses all inclusive as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to maximum of 1% of the sum insured per day.
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at 1% of the sum insured per day, limiting your choice and potentially reducing claim amounts if you select a higher room category.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Expenses incurred on treatment of Cataract is covered up to Rs.40,000/- per each eye in one policy year.
bad.explanation: A fixed limit of Rs.40,000 per eye for cataract treatment may lead to out-of-pocket expenses if actual costs exceed this amount.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern treatment... will be covered... up to 50% of Sum Insured, speciﬁed in the policy schedule, during the policy period:
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are covered only up to 50% of the sum insured, which may be insufficient for expensive procedures.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 20% applicable to claim amount admissible and payable as per the terms and conditions of the Policy.
bad.explanation: A mandatory 20% co-pay applies to all claims, meaning you pay one-fifth of every claim from your pocket unless you purchase a waiver.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Pre-Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 30 days prior to the date of hospitalization...
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered only for 30 days before admission, which is on the lower side and may exclude some earlier diagnostic or treatment costs.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: If during the period stated in the Policy Schedule... the Company will indemnify... but not exceeding sum insured stated in the Policy schedule.
bad.reference: Coverage > 2. COVERAGE (no restore/recharge wording found in provided pages)
bad.explanation: No restore or recharge benefit is provided, so your sum insured is not replenished after a claim within the same policy year.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Such associated medical expenses do not include Cost of pharmacy and consumables, Cost of implants and medical devices and Cost of diagnostics.
bad.reference: Definitions > Specific Definitions > Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Consumables like gloves, syringes, and implants are excluded, which means you may have to pay for these items separately.

bad.name: Co-pay Waiver
bad.quote: Waiver of Co-payment : Is available on payment of additional premium as per terms & conditions.
bad.explanation: A co-pay waiver add-on is available for extra premium, but details about eligibility and extent of waiver are not provided here.

unclear.name: No-Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Renewal of policy: The policy shall ordinarily be renewable except on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation by the Insured Person.
unclear.explanation: No information is provided about a no-claim bonus or renewal bonus, so it is unclear if you get any benefits for claim-free renewals or if the bonus resets after a claim.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless facility can be availed only in networked Hospitals. For details of Networked Hospitals, the insured may visit www.starhealth.in...
unclear.reference: Conditions > Claim Settlement > B (Documents for Cashless Treatment)
unclear.explanation: The size and coverage of the cashless hospital network is not stated, so you should verify if your preferred hospitals are included.
